title: Jill and the Bell
learning_objectives: Decode words ending in ll, ss, ff, zz
Review all five short vowels in one story
parent_prompts: New pattern: two letters at the end make one sound: bell, hiss, puff, buzz.
After reading: what did the bee sit on? Why did Jill keep still?

pages.text: Jill has a bell. Ding! Jill has a doll. The doll has a bell too.
pages.illustration_brief: A girl with plaits holding a small brass bell; a cloth doll with a tiny bell on its hat.
pages.audio_script: Jill has a bell. Ding! Jill has a doll. The doll has a bell too.
pages.image_alt: A girl with plaits holding a small brass bell; a doll with a tiny bell.

pages.text: Jill sits on the hill. Hiss, hiss. It is the wind.
pages.illustration_brief: The girl on a grassy hill, grass bending in the wind.
pages.audio_script: Jill sits on the hill. Hiss, hiss. It is the wind.
pages.image_alt: The girl on a grassy hill, grass bending in the wind.

pages.text: Jill puffs. Puff, puff! Off go the bits of fluff.
pages.illustration_brief: The girl blowing a dandelion clock; white seeds drifting off.
pages.audio_script: Jill puffs. Puff, puff! Off go the bits of fluff.
pages.image_alt: The girl blowing a dandelion clock; white seeds drifting off.

pages.text: Buzz! A bee. It buzzes at the bell. It buzzes at the doll.
pages.illustration_brief: A round bee circling the bell in the girl's hand.
pages.audio_script: Buzz! A bee. It buzzes at the bell. It buzzes at the doll.
pages.image_alt: A round bee circling the bell in the girl's hand.

pages.text: Jill is still. The bee sits on the bell. Then it is off.
pages.illustration_brief: The bee resting on the bell; the girl frozen with a careful face.
pages.audio_script: Jill is still. The bee sits on the bell. Then it is off.
pages.image_alt: The bee resting on the bell; the girl frozen with a careful face.

pages.text: Ding, hiss, puff, buzz. Jill tells Mum all of it.
pages.illustration_brief: The girl at home, arms wide, talking to Mum; four small sound motifs above.
pages.audio_script: Ding, hiss, puff, buzz. Jill tells Mum all of it.
pages.image_alt: The girl at home, arms wide, talking to Mum; four small sound motifs above.

quiz.explanation: p-u-ff. The two f letters at the end make one f sound.
Page 2 says: Hiss, hiss. It is the wind.

options.text: A bee is on her bell

quiz.explanation: The bee buzzes at the bell (page 4), Jill is still and the bee sits on the bell, then goes (page 5).

quiz.prompt: Tell a grown-up the four sounds Jill heard and what made each one.
quiz.rubric: not yet: one sound; with support: two sounds with prompting; independent: ding bell, hiss wind, puff fluff, buzz bee
quiz.explanation: Pairing each sound with its source shows the child tracked all four pages.

activities.prompt: Match the sound to what made it.

activities.claim: Keeping still let the bee leave on its own.

off_screen_prompt: Go outside or open a window. Listen for one minute. Tell someone three sounds you heard.

review.decodability_note: Double-final: Jill, bell, doll, hill, hiss, puff(s), off, fluff, buzz(es), all, tell(s), still. Short vowels: sits, wind, bits, Mum, then, go. 'ding', 'too', 'go', 'then', 'wind' are decodable by letter-sound but outside the taught list; introduce first.
